title: धनुषामा श्रीमतीको हत्या गरी श्रीमानले गरे आत्महत्या, चार वर्षीय छोरा घाइते
content:
No ads found for this position जनकपुरधाम । धनुषामा धारिलो हतियार प्रहार गरी श्रीमतीको हत्या गरेपछि श्रीमान् झुण्डिएको अवस्थामा मृत फेला परेका छन् । घटनामा चार वर्षीय छोरा घाइते भएका छन् । जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालय धनुषाका प्रवक्ता एवं डिएसपी ओम प्रकास खनालका अनुसार धनुषाको गणेशमान चारनाथ नगरपालिका–४, भरतपुर निवासी ३५ वर्षीय उमेश यादव कात्तिक ७ गते राति करिब ९ बजे मिथिला बिहारी नगरपालिका–३, मिथिलेश्वरस्थित ससुराली पुगेका थिए । सोही बिहान करिब १ः५० बजे उमेशले ३० वर्षीया श्रीमती रिना र उनीहरूसँगै सुतिरहेका चार वर्षीय छोरा सम्राट यादवमाथि धारिलो हतियार प्रहार गरेको सूचना प्रहरीलाई प्राप्त भएको थियो । सूचना प्राप्त भएपछि इलाका प्रहरी कार्यालय धनुषाधामबाट प्रहरी निरीक्षक राजेश कुमार शर्माको कमान्डमा प्रहरी टोली घटनास्थल पुगेको थियो । प्रहरी टोलीले रिनाको घाँटीमा धारिलो हतियारले काटिएको चोट रहेको र उनको मृत्यु भइसकेको अवस्थामा फेला पारेको थियो । बालक सम्राटको दाहिने तिघ्रामा काटिएको चोट लागेको थियो । घाइते बालकलाई तत्काल स्थानीय क्लिनिकमा प्राथमिक उपचार गराई थप उपचारका लागि प्रादेशिक अस्पताल जनकपुर पठाइएको प्रवक्ता खनालले बताए । उनको अवस्था सामान्य रहेको प्रहरीले जनाएको छ । घटनास्थलबाट प्रहरीले रगत लागेको चक्कुसमेत बरामद गरेको छ । श्रीमतीको हत्या र छोरामाथि आक्रमण भएको घटनापछि उमेश घटनास्थलबाट फरार भएका थिए । प्रहरीले उनको खोजतलास गर्ने क्रममा घटनास्थलबाट करिब एक किलोमिटर पश्चिम मिथिला बिहारी नगरपालिका–२ मा सिर्सिया जाने बाटोको दक्षिणपट्टि रहेको आँपको रुखमा झुण्डिएको अवस्थामा उनको शव फेला पारेको थियो । घटनापछि प्रहरीले रिनाको शव परीक्षणका लागि प्रादेशिक अस्पताल जनकपुर पठाइएको छ । पहिलो घटनास्थलको मुचुल्का सम्पन्न भइसकेको छ भने उमेशको शव फेला परेको दोस्रो घटनास्थलको मुचुल्का गर्ने कार्य जारी रहेको प्रहरीले जनाएको छ । घटनाको कारण खुल्न बाँकी रहेको र प्रहरीले घटनाबारे थप अनुसन्धान गरिरहेको जनाएको छ । Janakpurdham. A husband was found hanging after killing his wife with a sharp weapon in Dhanusha. His four-year-old son was injured in the incident. According to Om Prakash Khanal, spokesperson and DSP of the District Police Office, Dhanusha, Umesh Yadav, 35, a resident of Bharatpur, Ganeshman Charnath Municipality-4, Dhanusha, had reached his in-laws' house in Mithila Bihari Municipality-3, Mithileshwor, at around 9 pm on Kartik 20. At around 1:50 that morning, police received information that Umesh had attacked his 30-year-old wife Reena and four-year-old son Samrat Yadav with a sharp weapon while they were sleeping. Upon receiving the information, a police team under the command of Police Inspector Rajesh Kumar Sharma from the Area Police Office, Dhanushadham reached the spot. The police team found Reena with a cut wound on her neck and she was dead. The boy Samrat had a cut wound on his right thigh. Spokesperson Khanal said that the injured child was immediately given first aid at a local clinic and sent to the Provincial Hospital in Janakpur for further treatment. Police said that his condition is normal. Police have also recovered a blood-stained knife from the incident site. Umesh had fled the scene after the murder of his wife and the attack on his son. During a search for him, police found his body hanging from a mango tree on the south side of the road to Sirsia in Mithila Bihari Municipality-2, about one kilometer west of the scene. Following the incident, police have sent Reena's body to the Janakpur Provincial Hospital for an autopsy. The first incident report has been completed, while the second incident report, where Umesh's body was found, is in progress, police said. The cause of the incident is yet to be determined and police are conducting further investigations into the incident.

A husband was found hanging after killing his wife with a sharp weapon in Dhanusha. His four-year-old son was injured in the incident. According to Om Prakash Khanal, spokesperson and DSP of the District Police Office, Dhanusha, Umesh Yadav, 35, a resident of Bharatpur, Ganeshman Charnath Municipality-4, Dhanusha, had reached his in-laws' house in Mithila Bihari Municipality-3, Mithileshwor, at around 9 pm on Kartik 20. At around 1:50 that morning, police received information that Umesh had attacked his 30-year-old wife Reena and four-year-old son Samrat Yadav with a sharp weapon while they were sleeping. Upon receiving the information, a police team under the command of Police Inspector Rajesh Kumar Sharma from the Area Police Office, Dhanushadham reached the spot. The police team found Reena with a cut wound on her neck and she was dead. The boy Samrat had a cut wound on his right thigh. Spokesperson Khanal said that the injured child was immediately given first aid at a local clinic and sent to the Provincial Hospital in Janakpur for further treatment. Police said that his condition is normal. Police have also recovered a blood-stained knife from the incident site. Umesh had fled the scene after the murder of his wife and the attack on his son. During a search for him, police found his body hanging from a mango tree on the south side of the road to Sirsia in Mithila Bihari Municipality-2, about one kilometer west of the scene. Following the incident, police have sent Reena's body to the Janakpur Provincial Hospital for an autopsy. The first incident report has been completed, while the second incident report, where Umesh's body was found, is in progress, police said. The cause of the incident is yet to be determined and police are conducting further investigations into the incident.
